name: Gallusian
description: Gallusians were a sentient species that existed in the galaxy. Luleo Primoc, who was a chart-topping singer who also performed on the First Light, was a member of this species. Bosnok was a Gallusian with a knack for numbers; the Imperial Governor Thorden offered him a job managing records of the Empire's shady dealings on the Outer Rim moon Toshara.
